items.name: 01-hero
items.prompt: Photorealistic interior photography, real estate photo, Scandinavian farmhouse style, realistic proportions, clean and calm, no people, no text, no labels, no logos, no brand names, plain unbranded stuffed animals with no tags or printed faces of known characters, generic plush bears, bunnies, elephants and dogs in soft neutral colors, high detail. Palette: white oak, cream, sage green, terracotta accents, natural daylight. A bright, tidy child's bedroom corner with a freestanding white oak stuffed animal storage tower about 4 feet tall: an open wooden frame with vertical sage green elastic straps across the front, filled with generic plush toys that can be pulled out between the straps. Beside it a low cream fabric basket with a few plush toys, a white oak toddler bed with a cream quilt and no toys on it, a round jute rug and a large window with linen curtains. Wide view, calm and organized.
